2607.28257.title: Operationally Guided Placement-Aware Learning for Industrial Online 3D Bin Packing
2607.28257.paper_summary: The online three-dimensional bin packing problem (3D-BPP) is a longstanding challenge in logistics and industrial palletizing. Recent learning-based methods use a learned policy to select among feasible candidate placements. Performance depends on the candidate generator and representation, especially in industrial settings where packings must be space-efficient, stable, compact, and balanced. However, prior work has mainly optimized the policy, while candidate generation and representation remain largely geometry-driven. We address this gap with OPAL, an operationally guided placement-aware learning framework for industrial online 3D-BPP which combines an Operationally Guided Empty-Maximal-Space generator (OG-EMS), an operational representation for each candidate placement, and a masked ranking policy trained with proximal policy optimization. OG-EMS evaluates multiple anchors within each free-space region and prioritizes low, well-supported, compact, and spatially diverse placements. An xLSTM-based Placement Encoder models dependencies among geometric and operational candidate attributes, while a lightweight recurrent core combines the resulting embeddings with the current item and pallet state to rank feasible actions. On the BED-BPP benchmark, OPAL achieves a mean space utilization of 0.49, with improvements of 15.1% from operationally guided candidate generation and 6.3% from learned ranking, while maintaining robust inference-time performance.
2607.28257.paper_summary_zh: 在線三維裝箱問題（3D-BPP）是物流和工業裝載中的一項長期挑戰。最近的基於學習的方法使用學習的策略來選擇可行的候選放置。性能取決於候選生成器和表示，尤其是在工業環境中，裝載必須是空間高效、穩定、緊湊和均衡的。然而，以往的工作主要優化了策略，而候選生成和表示仍然在很大程度上是以幾何為驅動。我們通過OPAL來解決這一空白，這是一個針對工業在線3D-BPP的運營引導放置感知學習框架，結合了一個運營引導的空最大空間生成器（OG-EMS）、每個候選放置的運營表示，以及使用近端策略優化訓練的掩碼排名策略。OG-EMS在每個自由空間區域內評估多個錨點，並優先考慮低、支撐良好、緊湊和空間多樣的放置。一個基於xLSTM的放置編碼器建模幾何和操作候選屬性之間的依賴關係，而一個輕量級的遞歸核心將生成的嵌入與當前項目和托盤狀態結合，以對可行的行動進行排名。在BED-BPP基準測試中，OPAL實現了0.49的平均空間利用率，來自運營引導候選生成的改進為15.1%，來自學習排名的改進為6.3%，同時保持穩健的推斷時間性能。
